info.name: Gezyne Laboratory Information System (LIS) API
info.description: Complete API test collection for Gezyne LIS Server covering all 18 clinical, laboratory, financial, and administrative modules.

request.description: Authenticates user credentials and issues a signed JWT Bearer token.
Verifies current Bearer token claims and validity.
Client-side session keepalive endpoint (prevents idle timeout).
Retrieves HTML login form containing anti-CSRF token.
Invalidates current cookie-based session.
Main administrative dashboard view.
Real-time KPI aggregations (daily patients, tests processed, pending releases).
JSON summary endpoint for mobile and kiosk clients.
Returns list of registered patients.
Registers patient and automatically assigns a unique MRN.

Updates patient information.
Fast autocomplete search by MRN or Name.
Real-time queue board across all 10 clinical stations.
Queues patient for phlebotomy / specimen extraction.
Marks extraction done and routes patient to next ordered service (e.g. ECG, X-Ray, Laboratory).
Reverses an accidental station completion.
Filters diagnostic tests by status (Pending, In Progress, Verified, Released).
Creates new diagnostic test order for patient.
